privileges: Privileges for cardholders of Chulalongkorn University Book Center
book_center_members: Book center members will receive a 10 - 15% discount for purchasing books throughout the 1 year membership period. This privilege can be used at all branches. (Except N-code books, journals, and stationery)
receive_news: Receive news about new books And interesting activities From the book center always
can_participate: Can participate in activities for members "Member Relations" organized by the Book Center Along with receiving special privileges From many service establishments / participating stores
companies_stores: Companies, stores that want to join giving members benefits Book centers, please contact Pornthip Chareonsuk, member department, telephone 0-2218-9891
about_accumulation: About the accumulation of membership card at Chulalongkorn University Book Center
just_apply: Just apply to be a member of the Chula Book Center. You can get discounts and can accumulate points immediately. The accumulation of points is divided according to the type of membership card, Chulalongkorn Book Center, as follows
after_discount: Chula Book Center membership card for all types. Just buy products over 100 baht. You have the right to receive reward points immediately. By calculating from the value after discount
collecting_points: Chula VIP Book Center membership card type, please show the rights to collect points at all public relations counters first. To start collecting points the next day
in_case: In case of canceling the membership of the Chula Book Center, the reward points on the card will expire immediately and cannot be Can be redeemed for prizes
cash_coupon: Purchase products from every Chula Book Center shop, every 100 baht. Receive 1 reward point, accumulate 200 points, and receive a 100 baht cash coupon.
application_fee: Membership Application Fee, Chula Book Center, Price 100 Baht
can_apply: Can apply for a membership card at the Chula Book Center At every Chula Book Center store
